title: Claude Opus 5.5 builds daydreams that hold together
format_note: Screen-captured web app (brick-model builder) alternating with cream-ground infographic cutaways; no voiceover, captions or headline; a typed prompt is the only story copy.
one_thing: Claude designs a 2,874-piece brick model, proves every part connects, then rebuilds a castle from a typed request and writes the manual.

transcript.voice_style: No voice. Captions hold only [music] tags and a single '>> Ah!' at 00:22.
transcript.script_shape: Silent story told by UI: finished model, verification cutaway, empty-canvas build timelapse, user prompt, revision, manual, library, Claude logo.

structure.frame0: Whole app window on a sage-green ground, finished Canal Clock Square model centred, library list left, red Download button; the subject is present (f0001.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Hard switch at ~1.9s from app window to bare cream stage; model reduced to a clock tower and houses with an orange bounding frame that sweeps over it (strips/window-01-1.75s.jpg).

beats.what: App window with finished 2,874-piece Canal Clock Square model.
Cream stage, orange frame scans the model.
Model explodes into layers beside 38.4 x 38.4 x 50.9 cm size readout.
Wireframe of joints: counters run to 17,452 and 15,880 stud joints, 4,393 and 4 flags.
Single stacked column shows one weak joint; fixed column and six models show 0 warnings with ticks.
Parts-tree of 113 unique pieces, 53 sub-builds, then assembled model.
Parts laid out, then stat row 2,874 pieces, 487 steps, 498 pages, 0.80 s compile, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
Back in the app: Alpine Chalet builds from an empty baseplate, step 1/60 to 48/60, to finished roof.
Camera pushes into chat box; 'Create a medieval castle' typed, Claude saves final version at 47 s.
Stone Castle appears; user types watch-tower, drawbridge and moat request in the box.
Blurred zoom out; 'Planning the shape' spinner, 1 min 21 s.
Updated 2,057-piece castle with moat, drawbridge, blue-spire watchtower; orbit and front view.
Manual tab: page 1 baseplate, page 4 blue plates, watchtower sub-build pages 138 and 161 of 326.
Library tab: Friendly Robot and Canal Clock Square manual covers, returns to model.
UI fades to cream; star mark appears, letters type on to read 'Claude'.

hero_moment.what: Castle swaps to the revised build: moat, plank drawbridge and tall blue-roofed watchtower appear at once after the prompt wait.

ending.what: Star mark pops at 83.9s, wordmark typed letter by letter by 84.3s, held on plain off-white to the end.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Fast 1-6 s shots with counters ticking in the first 26 s, then one 34 s continuous screen recording (26.7-60.8 s, 39.5% of runtime) carried by camera pushes and UI states, then 1-6 s shots again. No burst of cuts.

look.ground: Two grounds: sage-green desktop around a floating app window, and warm cream gradient with vignette for infographic cutaways; final logo on off-white.
look.accent_use: Orange marks measurement and action: scan frame, joint wireframe, weak-joint ring, Download and Send buttons, progress bars, thin underline under stats.
look.type: Heavy grotesque sans numerals with small uppercase tracked labels (PIECES, STEPS, WEAK JOINT); light grey captions; Claude serif wordmark at the end.
look.depth: Soft contact shadows under isometric models, wireframe-to-solid crossfades, exploded layers; UI windows sit as flat cards with a drop shadow on green.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Digital zoom and blur-push into the chat box at 34.4-36 s and again near 55.9 s; the window is otherwise shown whole with the model filling the right pane.
product_ui.notes: Whole-window shots keep chat and tab text at about 7-10 px, unreadable on a phone; zoomed chat box text reaches about 20 px. The 'Some sections of demo are accelerated' disclaimer sits bottom right throughout (crops/disclaimer.png).

motion.text_entry: Counters tick up numerically with an icon at left, new rows stack beneath; chat prompts type character by character with a caret; the logo letters type on.
motion.ui_motion: Model assembles piece by piece with a scrubbing progress bar, step counter and 4x speed; tabs switch Model to Manual to Library; manual thumbnails scroll; cursor clicks real controls.
motion.camera: Orbit and spin on the model; exploded-layer rise; digital push into the input box with motion blur; later pull back; dolly across wireframe.
motion.eases: Not measured numerically; counters decelerate near their final value (13,786 held twice at 5.77-5.78 s), pushes ease out with blur at 34.6 s.

good.observation: Frame 0 is the finished product in its app, so the subject is visible before any motion; the first cutaway follows within 2 s.
good.evidence: f0001.jpg; first cut region t=1.9 s

good.observation: Every stat row is a few bold numerals with a tiny label, so the proof claims (0 errors, 0 warnings, 4 to 0 weak joints) read in under 2 s each.
The problem is shown, not captioned: a five-brick column gets an orange ring on its weak joint, then turns blue with ticks.
A real typed prompt and a real reply with specific edits makes the revision believable; the model change at 60.8 s matches the reply text.
Honest disclosure: a small fixed caption says some sections are accelerated, and a visible 47 s and 1 min 21 s spinner shows true waiting.
Restrained palette: one orange accent, two grounds, near-black numerals; the models supply all the colour.

weak.observation: Whole-window UI shots put chat and tab text at roughly 7-10 px on a 720 p frame, unreadable on a phone; only the zoomed box is legible.
One 34 s unbroken screen recording (39.5% of runtime) has no cut, and much of it is a spinner and typing, so the pace drops against the first 26 s.
No headline, voice or end line says what the product is; viewers learn it only from small chat copy and the closing wordmark.
Audio is -19.8 LUFS integrated and not locked to cuts, so the music neither lifts the hero swap nor meets a social loudness target.

rule_candidates.rule: Prove a claim with a before/after of one tiny object (one flagged joint, then ticks) before showing the large result with the same counters.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0007.jpg then f0008.jpg then f0012.jpg at 12-22 s

rule_candidates.rule: Stat captions of 1-3 words with an icon and an uppercase label, numerals at 5-7% of frame height, hold at least 1.3 s each.
A long screen recording can carry up to 40% of runtime if it contains a visible user action and a visible outcome (typed prompt, spinner, revised model).
Switch between whole-window shots and cream-ground cutaways about 1.9 s into the film, so the product frame at 0 s is followed by a graphic proof frame inside 2 s.
Push the camera 2x or more into the input box before typing, so the long prompt reaches about 20 px glyph height at 1280 px wide.
Place the revision payoff after a visible wait of about 5 s and swap the whole model in a single frame at a section boundary of the music.
rule_candidates.evidence: cut at 60.77 s; strips/window-40-60.734s.jpg; section D 42.7-67.3 s

rule_candidates.rule: Keep a bold counter in one corner and the subject on the opposite side, using the empty cream third for the numbers.
Close on the logo in a plain ground with the mark first, then the wordmark typed on within 0.4 s, and hold it at least 2 s.
